Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Internet of things [ECE_4412]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Compare the distinct purposes and functionalities of Azure IoT Hub and SensorCloud.                     (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           A customized surveillance system receives videos from multiple cameras distributed in the field via     (5)  
  wireless channel and visualizes them on a shared LCD screen. Design a comprehensive protocol  
  for validating the performance of the surveillance system.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
2)                A smart home network connects a moderate number of devices like sensors, lights, and smart plugs (5)  
  within a limited, controlled area. Key needs include ease of setup, low power consumption, and  
  A)           moderate reliability. Evaluate the performance of different network topologies in this application  
  context.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Justify the choice of specific network topology and modulation technique in LoRa.                       (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Differentiate Eclipse Kura and openHAB.                                                                 (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Identify the tools within Amazon Web Services that are suitable for data storage and analysis in an     (5)  
  IoT paradigm and evaluate the contextual application and suitability of each tool in terms of the  
  specifications.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Create"  
  
4)                Demonstrate the application of Azure DevOps for designing an IoT application in which a wireless        (5)  
  sensor network is deployed for environmental monitoring.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Design the basic layout of an IoT and cloud-inspired home automation system exclusively for             (5)  
  HVAC, lighting, and basic home appliances control.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Create"  
  
  Page #1

5)                        Illustrate two application contexts that can show the differences in edge computing and fog            (5)  
  computing?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                How does the separation of the control plane and the data plane, which is a foundational principle of (5)  
  Software-Defined Networking (SDN), enable the dynamic, programmable, and scalable software-  
  defined cloud infrastructure?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
